notes: Starting cards as marked '(START)': Do, Or Do Not, Insurrection, Staging Areas and Yarna d'al' Gargan, with the Objective (the strategy says to start the two Tatooine locations with Tanus Spijek as the rep). Several Effects start, so starting.effect is left empty. Total 60 as published.

Posted 'Income Enginner x2' under Effects dested Incom Corporation, as the post itself says: 'The Income Engineer x2 under effects are really Incon Corporations.' The 'Incom Engineer x2' under Characters is the Special Edition character Incom Engineer.

Posted 'Hutt Trade Route' dested Tatooine: Hutt Trade Route (Desert); 'Tatt DB' Tatooine: Docking Bay 94; 'Hoth DB' Hoth: Echo Docking Bay; 'Tattoine x3' three copies of the Tatooine system, kept as posted; 'Zev' Zev Senesca; 'Yarna D Gargin' Yarna d'al' Gargan; 'Manuvering Flaps' Maneuvering Flaps. Wise Advice and Do, Or Do Not are the older Effects.
The post is a joke-titled but real list, built to get Steven Lewis's attention about the uncut sheet the poster won at the Nashville GS (the deck itself is not said to have been played there).
